author: Andrew Fisher
scope: Independent CPU geometry and animation/selection preservation audit
limitations: No GPU browser used; appearance, shader compatibility, real draw timing and phone frame rate require integrated browser checks.
Outward winding tested on isolated convex primitives; final assemblies checked for winding agreement with stored vertex normals.
CPU construction timings are diagnostic single samples, not a performance benchmark.
